title: Exploring the wasteland in Arkansas 2125
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm a solo developer working on Arkansas 2125, an isometric, turn-based post-apocalyptic RPG inspired by Fallout 1, Fallout 2, and other classic RPGs.

The game takes place in a ruined America in the year 2125. You can explore abandoned locations, meet survivors, complete quests, make choices, and fight enemies in turn-based combat.

The game is currently in Beta 0.5, and I'm slowly working on Beta 0.6 with more content and improvements.

For a limited time, Arkansas 2125 is also available at 25% off on Steam if you'd like to give it a try.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546490/Arkansas\_2125/

I'd love to hear what you think about the game and its retro-inspired style. ☢️
